notes.title: Update 2/6/2025
notes.content:
Back with a small but exciting update.

After beating a boss, the game now gives you the option to fight the boss again on "hard mode" making it attack faster, stronger, and have more HP. Defeating hard mode bosses drops better loot.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed an issue causing cursor to disappear in start menu
